wiki.title: Macy Bolinske
wiki.extract: Macy Bolinske (née Christianson) is an American politician serving as a member of the North Dakota House of Representatives from the 40th district. A Republican, she was elected in the 2024 North Dakota House of Representatives election. In 2016, she was crowned Miss North Dakota and later competed in Miss America 2017. She was also crowned Miss North Dakota USA 2020 and competed at Miss USA 2020.
